integrity: The proof is self-contained beyond standard Chinese remainder, separable Hensel lifting and finite-field tensor decomposition. The bundled exhaustive checker tests finite instances and is not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Odd finite fields for zero-Jordan-product interpretation; monogenic commutative algebras only. Decomposition is noncanonical. Possible unindexed equivalent tensor-ideal computations. Independent audit not performed.
title: Zero-product tensor quotients of finite-field monogenic algebras are products of fat plane jets
